name: Cytotoxic chemotherapy
author: Jude Gomila
message: Editing pass: every TL;DR and summary stands alone

fields.before: "Drugs that kill rapidly dividing cells. Still curative in testicular cancer, lymphoma, leukaemia, and many early-stage cancers, and the warhead inside ADCs."
fields.after: "Cytotoxic chemotherapy drugs kill rapidly dividing cells. They are still curative in testicular cancer, lymphoma, leukaemia, and many early-stage cancers, and they are the warhead inside ADCs."
